description: This file defines the RecipeConfigurator class in the Drupal core, responsible for managing recipes, including loading, caching, and listing recipes and extensions.

classes.name: RecipeConfigurator
classes.description: Final class responsible for managing recipes, including loading, caching, and listing recipes and extensions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the configurator with a list of recipes and an include path, loading recipes accordingly.

methods.name: getIncludedRecipe
methods.description: Retrieves a recipe object based on include path and name, utilizing cache and handling missing recipes.

methods.name: listAllRecipes
methods.description: Returns all recipes installed by this recipe, including dependencies.

methods.name: listAllExtensions
methods.description: Lists all modules and themes installed by this recipe and its dependencies.
